item.title: The Role of Healthcare Simulation in the Reduction of Medical Errors
item.description: The pursuit of patient safety remains the primary driver for innovation within the healthcare simulation community. Medical errors pose a significant challenge for healthcare systems worldwide and often result from communication breakdowns, technical failures, or poor situational awareness. Clinical simulation provides a controlled environment where professionals practice high-stakes procedures without risk to a live patient. […]

item.title: Will AI Reduce the Role of Healthcare Simulation Educators?
item.description: Will Artificial Intelligence (AI) reduce the role of the healthcare simulation educator? This question is increasingly asked as AI rapidly enters healthcare simulation through virtual patients, automated scenario facilitation, and AI-assisted debriefing tools. As these technologies advance, simulation educators naturally question their future role. If AI can run scenarios, adapt to learner responses, and generate […]

item.title: Pre-Briefing in Healthcare Simulation: Beginner’s Guide and Downloadable Template
item.description: Pre-Briefing serves as an essential first step in a healthcare simulation experience, yet this phase is often overlooked or rushed.
